tools.name: undeploy_module
tools.description: Undeploy a reusable module from an environment (STAGING or PRODUCTION).

tools.name: create_module
tools.description: Create a reusable module (a typed config fragment referenced by handle) and optionally deploy it to staging or production. spec_yaml is base64-encoded YAML of the module body; module_type is the config struct it represents (e.g. Database).

tools.name: update_config
tools.description: Update an existing AirPipe configuration by config_uuid (config_yaml is base64-encoded YAML) and optionally redeploy.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations you belong to and their organization_uuid. Call this first to get an organization_uuid for the config tools.

tools.name: delete_module
tools.description: Delete one or more reusable modules by module_uuid.

tools.name: update_module
tools.description: Update an existing reusable module by module_uuid (adds a new revision; spec_yaml is base64-encoded YAML) and optionally redeploy.

tools.name: toggle_config
tools.description: Enable or disable one or more configurations by config_uuid.

tools.name: delete_config
tools.description: Delete one or more AirPipe configurations by config_uuid.

tools.name: edit_config
tools.description: Edit an AirPipe configuration YAML with a natural-language instruction.

tools.name: validate_config
tools.description: Schema-validate an airpipe YAML config. Send { "yaml": <the full YAML string> }. Returns { valid: true } when it passes, or { valid: false, error: <message> } when it fails — feed the error back into your fix and call again until valid. Schema check only; does not save. Use create_config to persist

tools.name: create_config
tools.description: Create a new AirPipe configuration (config_yaml is base64-encoded YAML) and optionally deploy it to staging or production.

tools.name: deploy_config_revision
tools.description: Deploy a specific past revision of a configuration to staging or production.

tools.name: undeploy_config
tools.description: Undeploy a configuration from an environment (STAGING or PRODUCTION).

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List the organization's reusable modules (pass revisions=true to include revision history).

tools.name: deploy_module_revision
tools.description: Deploy a specific past revision of a module to staging or production.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: Get a single reusable module by uuid, including its revision history and spec.

tools.name: plan_config
tools.description: Get airpipe config-authoring instructions plus RAG-retrieved real action examples for a natural-language request, so YOU (the calling model) write the YAML yourself instead of the server generating it. Returns { instructions, context, request, protocol }. After writing the config, validate it with t

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Get a single configuration's data by config_uuid, optionally with its revisions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_config · Private data: create_module · Public sink: validate_config · Destructive: delete_module, delete_config.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_config · Private data: create_module · Public sink: validate_config · Destructive: delete_module, delete_config

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
